about: tool-key imports (rvr tool FILE KEY --set DATA.json, docs/SPEC.md §8.11): each KEY and the text of DATA.json, set on rvr/valid/fixture.rvr, with its verdict; see README.md

cases.rule: FORMAT §1 §11 nesting to 64 deep, counted from its place
FORMAT §11 a name of letters, digits, _, - and .

cases.rust_says: the tool key my-tool must be one JSON object (docs/FORMAT.md §11): write its data as one object, { … }
the tool key my-tool is not JSON as docs/FORMAT.md §1 reads it (EOF while parsing a value at line 1 column 6): write its data as one JSON object
the tool key my-tool is not JSON as docs/FORMAT.md §1 reads it (expected value at line 1 column 1): write its data as one JSON object
the tool key my-tool breaks docs/FORMAT.md §1: ["my-tool"].a is written twice (line 1, column 12): write its data as a header's rules say
the tool key my-tool breaks docs/FORMAT.md §1: ["my-tool"].a[0] is written -0 (line 1, column 9): write its data as a header's rules say

cases.rule: FORMAT §1 no key the JSON reader takes for a number
cases.rust_says: the tool key my-tool breaks docs/FORMAT.md §1: ["my-tool"].n["$serde_json::private::Number"] is a key no header holds, as the JSON reader takes it for a number (line 1, column 44): write its data as a header's rules say
the tool key my-tool is not JSON as docs/FORMAT.md §1 reads it (unexpected end of hex escape at line 1 column 14): write its data as one JSON object

cases.rule: FORMAT §1 §11 nesting at most 64, counted from its place

cases.rust_says: "my tool" is not a tool key's name, which is one or more ASCII letters, digits, _, - and . (docs/FORMAT.md §11): rename the tool key

cases.rule: FORMAT §11 a tool key's name: not empty
cases.rust_says: "" is not a tool key's name, which is one or more ASCII letters, digits, _, - and . (docs/FORMAT.md §11): rename the tool key

cases.rule: FORMAT §11 not a slip of the format's own keys
cases.rust_says: the top-level key "Data" is a slip of data, one of the format's own keys, not a tool key (docs/FORMAT.md §11): give the tool key a name further from it

cases.rule: FORMAT §2 §11 not the format's own key
cases.rust_says: made is the format's own key, not a tool key (docs/FORMAT.md §2, §11): give the tool key a name of its own
